summary: Errors like No package 'libffi' found or Python.h missing during Ansible installation come from missing OS-level dependencies of Python packages (for example paramiko needs pynacl which needs libffi); install them with the OS package manager.
questions: pip install ansible fails with 'No package libffi found', what do I install?
How do I fix 'fatal error: Python.h: No such file or directory' when installing Ansible?

answer_card.title: Fix missing build deps when installing Ansible
answer_card.answer_md:
These errors mean OS-level build dependencies are missing (e.g. Ansible → paramiko → pynacl → **libffi**). Install them with your package manager, for example:

```bash
sudo dnf install libffi-devel python3-devel gcc
# or
sudo apt install libffi-dev python3-dev build-essential
```
